## Episode Thesis

This Norwegian Nordnet episode (Pengepodden) was recorded on the day of Anthropic's US IPO. The hosts compare Anthropic with OpenAI and talk through how they use AI tools, AI safety, cybersecurity and the chance that Claude becomes a work 'operating system' that challenges Microsoft Office. The market backdrop is described as nervous after a turbulent late autumn for AI stocks. Nvidia's strong quarterly results are seen as calming the market, and the IPO valuation is reported at roughly half the earlier ~USD 2 trillion estimates. No explicit buy or sell calls were made.
